title.tagline: A raccoon, some crickets, and a very good pile of garbage.
map.title: The Alley
about.possum: Slow and steady. Brooms barely budge them, and sometimes they flop over and pretend to nap.
about.crow: Flies right over fences, sprinklers and dogs.
about.rat: Nibbles at whatever's in the way until it gives up — even the yard dog!
pair.broomNeighbor: The neighbor can't stop swatting at crows!
pair.motionLight: The light just stares at possums!
story.alley: Jimothy has found the best garbage pile in the alley. He's going to need some help from his friends.
story.backyards: Over the fence lie the back yards: green bins, sleepy dogs and a whole lot of lawn to cross.
story.culdesac: The cul-de-sac has the fanciest recycling in town. And fences. So many fences.
story.stripmall: Behind the strip mall sits the biggest dumpster in the city. Jimothy has been dreaming about it all year.
story.finale.title: The biggest feast in Seattle!
story.finale: The whole troupe shares the best garbage in the city. Then everybody takes a very long nap. Thank you for playing!
intro.1-1: That pile behind the sprinkler? It's ours. Send the crickets!
intro.1-2: Two sprinklers tonight. Keep the crickets coming.
intro.1-3: A neighbor with a broom! Possum doesn't mind a little sweeping.
intro.1-4: Bigger pile, busier alley. Mix it up!
intro.1-5: The best pile in the whole alley. Everybody, go!
tutorial.card: Tap the crickets to send them!
tutorial.again: Keep sending! Hold to send lots.
pause.title: Paused
results.title: The pile is ours!
night.title: The sun's coming up — time for a nap.
night.tip.love: The {defense} kept turning friends back. It can't resist a {unit} — send one to keep it busy!
night.tip.chew: The {defense} kept turning friends back. A rat can nibble at it until it gives up!
night.tip.over: The {defense} kept turning friends back. A crow can fly right over it!
night.tip.lane: The {defense} kept turning friends back. Try a path it can't reach!
night.tip.hold: Hold a friend's card to send lots in a row!

intro.2-1: Back yards! The dog only guards one path. Pick the other one.
intro.2-2: Two dogs on top. Send a squirrel to keep them busy!
intro.2-3: Brooms on both paths. Possums don't mind a sweep!
intro.2-4: A motion light! Possums keep it busy, and crows fly over the dogs.
intro.2-5: The biggest back yard pile. A crow keeps the broom busy!
intro.3-1: Welcome to the cul-de-sac. Fancy lawns, fancy garbage.
intro.3-2: A fence! Rats can chew through it, and crows fly over.
intro.3-3: Three paths! Each one has its own trouble.
intro.3-4: Fences on both sides. Bring the rats!
intro.3-5: The cul-de-sac's grandest pile. Use every friend!
intro.4-1: The dumpster lot behind the strip mall. Smells amazing.
intro.4-3: Brooms and dogs everywhere. Mix up your troupe!
intro.4-4: Fences on every path! Rats to the front.
intro.4-5: The biggest pile in the whole city. This is it, everybody!
